categoriesPage.title: Categories
categoryPane.finePrint: A category is a line of work. It classifies the attempt and gives custody; it holds no share of its own. The shares shown belong to the selected mix and are edited on Mixes. Documents sit on leaves only; custody attaches anywhere and reaches everything under it.
categoryPane.noAttentionNeeded: Nothing. Every set adds up to 100 and every branch has somebody.
categoryPane.noDocumentsYet: None. It is a leaf, so it can classify documents; nothing has been approved into it yet.
categoryPane.refineExplanation: Documents sit on leaves only, so a category under {{category}} means moving these {{count}} into it — that is Refine.
categoryPane.rootCustodyExplanation: Custody over the whole tree is the any scope, a role granted in Users & Groups, not a grant here. Custody is granted on a category and reaches everything under it.
categoryPane.noOneReached: nobody — nobody’s validation queue holds it
categoryPane.custodyInheritance: Custody inherits downward: granted here, it also reaches every category under {{category}}.
categoryDialog.nameTaken: A category beside it already has that name.
categoryDialog.holdsDocuments: It holds documents, so it cannot take a child. Refine it instead, which moves them.
categoryDialog.hasChildren: It has categories under it now.
categoryDialog.intentionScoped: An intention is scoped to it. Change that intention’s categories first.
categoryDialog.forbidden: You may no longer change this part of the tree.
categoryDialog.custodyDescription: Who holds custody granted on {{name}}, the whole set.
categoryDialog.groupHint: everyone in one, while they are in it
categoryDialog.custodySummary: It reaches {{name}} and everything under it — {{count}} leaves. It makes them responsible; what they may do there is their role.
categoryDialog.boundedGrant: You grant it only inside {{names}}, which {{verb}} yours.
categoryDialog.newDescription: A line of work, under its parent.
categoryDialog.deleteNoDocuments: It holds no documents, so nothing moves.
categoryDialog.otherMixShare: {{count}} more mixes you cannot read give it a share, unallocated there too.
categoryDialog.noMixShare: It has no share in any mix, so no set changes.
categoryDialog.grantsGoWith: Custody granted on it ({{count}}) goes with it.
categoryDialog.scopedIntentions: {{count}} intentions scoped to it ({{names}}), so it cannot be deleted yet.
categoryDialog.deleteDescription: An empty leaf, removed from the tree.
categoryDialog.deletedShare: Its share is unallocated here, and flagged.
categoryDialog.createdText: Under {{parent}}, with no share in any mix yet, so its set is flagged until somebody gives it one.
categoryDialog.movedText: Now under {{parent}}, with no share there in any mix. Where it was, its share is unallocated.
categoryDialog.moveWarning: It starts with no share in its new place, in every mix — it cannot take from shares somebody already set there. Where it was, its share becomes unallocated and is flagged. Custody follows the tree: whoever holds its new place holds it.
categoryDialog.name: Name
categoryDialog.namePlaceholder: The line of work it stands for
categoryDialog.newCategoryHelp: It starts with no share in any mix — it cannot take from shares somebody already set. Give it one on Mixes.
categoryDialog.parentLeafHelp: {{parent}} holds no documents, so it simply stops being a leaf; nothing moves.
categoryDialog.moveHelp: Moving it takes everything under it along. A leaf that holds documents cannot take a child, so it is not offered.
refine.hasChildren: It has a category under it now; it is no longer a leaf.
refine.nameRequired: The new category needs a name.
refine.movedText: {{category}} is now a branch, and {{name}} holds its whole share.
refine.title: Refine {{name}}
refine.description: a leaf that holds documents gains a child
refine.nameStepHelp: Documents sit on leaves only, so {{category}} cannot hold documents and a child at once. All {{count}} of them move into the new category, and {{category}} becomes a branch. Sort them into further categories afterwards.
refine.otherMixes: {{count}} more mixes you cannot read, the same way
refine.mixExplanation: The new category takes all of {{category}}’s share in each mix, since it holds everything that was there. Left with none, the whole branch would drop out of generation. Custody on {{category}} still reaches them: it inherits down.
refine.historyExplanation: Their status does not change. Each one’s history records the move.
